dedupe_keys.name: false data injection on a 310 bus 20 kv distribution grid

description: False data injection on a 310-bus 20 kV distribution grid is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Stelios Dimoulias, Georgios Kryonidis. "This dataset contains the network configuration of a real 310-bus 20 kV active distribution grid. The PV plants operate under the Q-V droop characteristic. In addition, it contains several scenarios with sophisticated false data injection attacks.". Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
